commits.subject: Divisor classes from local equations (Wave-3 lane L2, file 4, delegated build): Scheme.LocalEquations packages one regular section per member of a pointed cover with unit overlap-ratios — the trivialization data of O(D) with transition units g i j = f_i/f_j; stalk-level regularity is the primitive (restrictions to sub-opens stay nonzerodivisors via sheaf section_ext), making the ratio unit UNIQUE, whence the cocycle identity on triple overlaps and the Čech Picard class picClass. Invariance ledger: refinement (picClass_restrict), unitwise rescaling via an explicit v⁻¹-coboundary (picClass_rescale), and multiplicativity on the common refinement (picClass_mul, anchored on mk_mul_mk_inf). Pullback compatibility deferred (line cap). Plus the algebra-map face of the relative Picard functor (Picard/RelPicAlgebra.lean): overSpecMap = Spec of a k-algebra map as an Over(Spec k) morphism, strictly functorial, and relPicAlgMap with functor laws — the interface the étale plus construction consumes. Both files kernel-green, axiom audits standard three; registered in the root
